title: Physiological demands of running at 2-hour marathon race pace
claims: Laboratory measurements in elite runners at 2-hour marathon race pace showed a ground contact time of 0.16 ± 0.01 s.
The same measurements showed a vertical oscillation of 0.04 ± 0.006 m.
Peak vertical force at that pace averaged 2.92 ± 0.26 body weights.
The reported values come from 10 world-class male runners at a single pace; the paper does not present them as representative of recreational runners.
